newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,773 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,773 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,773 contracts compared with 826 overnight Monday.
There were 203 wheat, 357 corn, 1,001 soybean, 102 soymeal, 80 soyoil, seven oat, six rice, five soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one to 7-1/2 cents higher, corn was 1-1/2 to two cents higher and soybeans were 11 to 12 cents higher.
